stemMd: Suppose the additional condition is: Accounts must be in position 1. Which further statement must then be true?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Accounts must not be in position 1.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Accounts and Orders must not occupy consecutive positions.

explanationMd:
First restrict attention to orders satisfying the extra condition as well as the original rules. There are 2 such orders. "Accounts and Orders must not occupy consecutive positions." holds throughout this restricted set; the other statements fail on the explicit examples in their feedback.

The remaining orders are:
- Accounts → Products → Branches → Orders → Customers
- Accounts → Products → Customers → Orders → Branches

distractorRationale.b: Even with the additional condition, Accounts → Products → Branches → Orders → Customers is permitted and makes this statement false.
